changeRule: Coordinator records rationale before a new comparison; never weaken or retroactively rescore a failed run.

desktop.role: quiet desktop, native served apps/web page

linux.role: isolated Linux simulation/API/history interference reference; required only if compiler selected

mainThreadPerDisplayedFrameMs.scope: all camera observation, queries, scoring, scheduling, transitions and final pose application; include zero-work displayed frames

steadyTotalCpuMsPerSecond.scope: sum camera main-thread and worker CPU; include messaging, serialization and rejected/cancelled work

additionalResidentMemoryMiB.scope: camera geometry, plans, caches, queues and worker copies; report peak and post-cleanup retained delta against disabled control

required: numeric request/inflight/queue/cache bounds declared before each candidate run

hardFailures: chest-only crop credited as a medium/full shot
camera changes actor motion or reads beyond public audience
visual.emergencyCuts: Count separately and in total cut ledger; timestamp cause/recovery and inspect every event; cannot exempt a discretionary cut by renaming it.
rubric: calm comfortable motion with framing slack
face and context preferences yielding to visibility
novelty, pacing and no repetitive tour

serverCompiler.io: Declare and verify a numeric I/O limit before qualification; absent effective controls disables compiler.
zeroTolerance: world clock or API waiting for camera artifacts

latencyRegression.rule: candidate minus compiler-off baseline <= max(0.05 * baseline, 2 ms)

serverCompiler.unknownRule: Retain counts, noise, raw samples and effective-limit evidence; inconclusive non-interference is unknown, never pass.

common: name an observed failure and incumbent/fallback
freeze one observable minimum useful gain before trial
same source/input/render pairing and two repeats
meet all absolute visual and resource bars with no hard regression
retain negative results; do not adopt solely on aggregate aesthetic score

methods.prediction: Improve a named turn/occlusion recovery interval without control-case comfort or cost regression.
methods.planner: Improve named feasible-shot readability or a timestamped uncomfortable transition beyond the incumbent, counting all search cost.
methods.worker: Improve measured frame pacing on an accepted workload after startup/transfer, with total CPU and memory within bars.
methods.compiler: Reduce measured static-query/build or repeated setup cost end to end, including download/decode, and pass paired server non-interference.
methods.broadcastComplexity: Improve timestamped scene selection/continuity/variety or purposeful motion in active and quiet sessions without readability or comfort regression.

statistics.percentiles: nearest rank: sorted samples[ceil(p*n)-1], p in {0.5,0.95,0.99}; empty set is unknown
statistics.aggregation: Report each repeat, mode, orientation, thermal and cold/warm cell separately; never hide a failing cell in a pooled percentile.
statistics.missing: Missing instrumentation, dropped samples or uninspected pixels yield unknown for affected claims.
